dispositions.topic_text: The objective eligibility rule for treating a constant-table row as contract-only with no independent product meaning
dispositions.reason: The criterion is the owner's for Registry (2026-11-27): which product rule needs the notion on its own; a row that exists only as a row of a constant table, whose fields name facts State 1 lists, has none. It is applied per model by the owner and the review, not by a mechanical test: today only ConfirmedOwnerAction is declared under it, and M30-M34 keep their records until each is reviewed. No history in the texts makes two outcomes observable (the round's own why).
